decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom hearing product that was already retained once, management is likely to continue justifying its prior investment and keep it unless results clearly deteriorate.
This branded earmold has strong strategic fit and a visible public commitment through its own webpage, which makes withdrawal unlikely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.
Although the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's main offer, its recent launch and dedicated page create enough sunk-cost and reputation pressure for management to give it more time.
The post-curing unit fits the firm's digital production direction, and despite limited visibility so far, recent development effort and core-market relevance favor continued support for now.
